status: Prototype specification; no historical trade-event results
user_hypothesis: Within the opening15minutes, observed two-way fluctuation may support small counter-move scalps while persistent directional moves should be avoided.

user_confirmed.entry: Immediate at stretch, no candle-close or turn-back confirmation

reference: First eligible trade at or after09:30 establishes fixed open O.

retained_candidate_grid.note: Retained candidates from earlier research, not optimized settings or a recommendation. Earlier1/2h results do not test this15minute-flat setup.

rules.entry: Fade a fresh outward crossing of O+D (short) or O-D (long) before09:45, when the selected policy is eligible. Immediate price-event benchmark; no confirmation of the current candle required.
rules.rearm: After an exit or rejected crossing, a subsequent observed trade must be strictly inside BOTH entry bands. Only a later outward crossing may initiate a new trade. A rejected crossing cannot fill later merely because the filter becomes eligible while price remains outside.
rules.concurrency: One position at a time, at most3 entries. An exit event cannot also re-arm or open another trade. No averaging down or size escalation.
rules.deadline: Cancel all new entries at09:45. Any open position is flattened at09:45 using an explicitly supplied contemporaneous deadline mark. If a needed mark is unavailable, the replay is incomplete; do not silently substitute a later tick, a future bar extreme or an unverified stale price.
rules.stop_target: Target and stop are anchored to the modeled entry. Triggering-event high/low data do not exist in the event model; only subsequent ordered price records can resolve exits.

policies.purpose: Unfiltered comparison with the same initial observation time as the filtered policy
Fixed candidate proxy for two-way conditions; not a validated trend detector
policies.eligible_from: At least120seconds of observed session history
policies.feature: E=absolute(current observed price minus last observed price at/before120seconds earlier) / high-low range of the price observations from that boundary anchor through the current event
policies.allow_when: A boundary anchor exists, range>0, E<=0.35
policies.timing: Uses only information already observed at the trigger. It does not wait for any candle to close. In the first2minutes it is unclassified and skips entries.
policies.limitation: A low E describes a return toward the start of the recent window; it cannot guarantee the next move is indecisive. The separate09:32 baseline distinguishes the policy from merely skipping the first2minutes.

execution.input: Ordered trade-price events for one cash session. Preserve supplied ordering for equal timestamps. No reconstructed OHLC path is treated as observed trades.
execution.fill: Illustrative zero-latency price-event benchmark at the observed crossing price, including gaps, with explicit trading friction. This is not evidence of executable bid/ask fills or queue priority.
execution.targets: Exit at the stated target when a subsequent event crosses it; no favorable gap improvement.
execution.stops: Exit at the worse observed price when a subsequent event reaches or gaps beyond the stop.

costs.note: Inherited illustrative fees and execution friction, not a verified broker quote.

execution.latency: No historical latency validation in this prototype. Freeze and implement any supported trade/quote latency stress before a scored historical campaign.
execution.deadline_mark: An explicit research execution mark, not an invented guaranteed fill. Provenance and contemporaneous timestamp must be retained by the historical adapter.

research_gates.no_historical_launch_before: Valid ordered trade-event dataset, deadline-mark provenance, approved acquisition if needed, data audit, execution-model verification and saved launch preview.
research_gates.candidate_selection: Only low_directional_progress candidates may be selected for the filtered hypothesis; eligible configuration with highest net / maximum daily closed-equity drawdown. Ties higher net, lower stretch, larger target. Retain both matched unfiltered controls and all failed/zero-trade cells. Do not infer filter value from improvement over all_open alone.
research_gates.subsequent_progression: Stop if development fails. If supported, evaluate selected configuration chronologically with baseline, doubled costs and a separately frozen supported execution-delay scenario. Later years only if priorfold passes. All years were previously inspected in other studies, so none is globally unseen.

data_feasibility.local_history: One-minute MNQ OHLCV only; finest local history remains unchanged.
data_feasibility.limitation: Minute candles do not reveal how many fresh intraminute excursion/re-entry cycles occurred or their order. Independently choosing favorable ordering for each trade does not create valid three-trade session bounds, because each exit changes later entry opportunities.
data_feasibility.current_scope: Build and synthetically verify an event replay; do not fabricate historical trades, reuse the old1/2h win rates, or label a few assumed OHLC paths as all-feasible bounds.
data_feasibility.prior_quote: The earlier $201.68 quote concerned longer09:30–11:46 windows and is not a necessary purchase commitment for this revised15-minute scope.

interpretation: The proposed advantage must come from a repeatable tendency for small counter-moves in conditions identifiable at entry, sufficient after losses and costs. Randomness or a high target-hit percentage alone does not establish positive expectancy.

workbench.note: Standalone event prototype. Existing minute-close workbench engine does not faithfully implement this repeated intrabar-entry rule.
